object_description: compact three-storey volume on a recessed base storey with a floating cantilever
design_condition: the volume is placed as the head of the campus in the sequence between the existing buildings, its plinth growing into the slope so that the street-side height is reduced and the green space towards the lake stays intact

positive: Precise position in the sequence of existing buildings, confidently appearing as the head of the campus
The recessed base storey reduces the height from the street and fits in well with the neighbouring buildings
Concentrating on a compact volume keeps the green space from the monastery to the lake intact
The plinth growing into the slope forms a convincing unit with the upper storeys
The floating cantilever forms a generous prelude to the large rooms in the plinth level
The central staircase brings light into the entrance zone and the rear corridor
The compact spatial arrangement of the base floor is welcomed
Triangular and trapezoidal cut-outs in the wall bulkheads form a spatially exciting sequence
The finely structured glass facade lends the building lightness and elegance
Conically tapered concrete elements give a dynamic, integral overall expression
The wide inner corridor and the spacious staircase are welcomed from an operational point of view
The striking position in the ensemble and the emblematic appearance are remarkable
negative: The embankment in front of the ground floor art classrooms has a restrictive effect
An exit and external lounge area on the second floor and the connection to the canteen are missing
Long-term flexibility is somewhat rigid and restricted by the wall panels
The usable area falls significantly short of the space allocation plan; rooms are missing or reduced
Room proportions and spatial relationships are not convincing in essential parts
Classrooms occupying the circulation space at the end facades work against the structure and the corridor lighting
The low area, volume and cost figures only result from the unfulfilled spatial programme
The break hall is located outside the building envelope
Structural implementation of the wall bulkheads with overhangs appears complex
The static load transfer of the parking garage does not match the slab structure above
